paragraphs.text: Velena was one of Shanna 's crew on the Weatherlight prior to its Compleation .

Velena was a member of the Weatherlight 's crew, specifically assigned to the weapons podium. She was mentioned to be on the alert during the battle with the bone dragon , indicating her role in the ship's defense. Velena had a sense of urgency and decisiveness, as demonstrated when she quickly identified the dragon and urged the crew to take action.

During the Weatherlight 's crash landing and subsequent repairs, Velena and other crew members, including Arvad and Elmegraun , set out to find Shanna and the others. They found Shanna's group along the trail and warned them of the danger that had befallen the Weatherlight. However, as Velena was explaining the situation, a surprise attack occurred. A flurry of sickly green powerbolts rained down on the group. Velena and Elmegraun were directly hit by the powerbolts, which melted them into puddles, killing them instantly.
